in_english.name: Joanna
in_english.long_meaning: Joanna is a feminine name derived from the Hebrew name Yochanan, meaning God is gracious, and appears in the New Testament as the name of a wealthy woman from Galilee who followed Jesus

biblical_reference.note: Joanna is mentioned as the wife of Chuza, a steward of King Herod, and a follower of Jesus

data.cultural_impact: The name Joanna continued to be popular in Christian communities throughout history. It was often used for girls born to wealthy families, as seen in the New Testament, who could support their communities and the spread of the Gospel. Later, upon embracing Christianity, names like Joanna became common in various European countries.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Joanna lies in its meaning: 'God is gracious'. It is a reminder that no matter our background, social status, or wealth, we all can recognize the grace of God in our lives. Joanna's devotion to supporting Jesus financially illustrates the importance of using our resources to spread His message and make a positive impact in the world.
